verdict.rationale: E-signature is a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, since competitors in this category ship native or first-party signing. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a native OneDrive e-signature feature or a documented first-party signing integration. The evidence covers only sharing, coauthoring, versioning, sync and Graph file APIs, none of which is signing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration
